newsitem.title: UK: UK grain cash and futures markets drift lower.
newsitem.headline: UK grain cash and futures markets drift lower.

text.p: UK cash and futures grain market drifted lower in currency affected trading on Tuesday.
"It's the same old story, rising currency, lack of farm selling and no one willing to take the chance and sell the market short," said one broker.
Fob prices were around one to 0.50 stg down in a tradeless market while delivered trade levels were little changed.
Old crop milling wheat 11 percent protein for June was fetching 109 stg on the south coast while feed wheat in East Anglia was trading from 87 down to 86 stg.
New crop Oct/Dec feed wheat in East Anglia traded at 95 stg.
LIFFE wheat futures closed with old crop Jul 1.40 stg down and new crop 1.10 to 0.50 stg lower on a total turnover of 231 lots.
LIFFE barley finished 0.75 to 045 stg down on a turnover of 12 lots.
